rules:
All monthly contributions allocated to strategy, zero core DCA.
DCA is a separate benchmark account only. Main model is dynamic_budget tau20
with original mirror-window exits; no coefficient or signal changes.
Buy-only and original full-window policies are diagnostic comparisons.
Monthly deposits, prices, dates and fees match all previous tests.
caveats: 2020–2023 uses FinLab combined TWSE+TPEx; 2023–2026 primary uses listed iStock, with a matched-calendar FinLab check.
Periods overlap in 2023 and are exploratory, not independent out-of-sample.
Adjusted total-return fractional units, buy/sell fee 0.1425%, ETF sales tax 0.1%, zero cash yield; no minimum fee or spread.
Monthly contributions enter cash; no routine purchases in the pure strategy.
Dynamic-model order counts are daily orders, not multi-day entry-cycle counts.
